On [[Galantos]], [[Al'solib'minet'ri City]] had '''diplomatic suites''' reserved for visiting representatives. In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], [[Persha]] led [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and some others to stay there.
